theorems.name: Submission.cmr_tdn_null_of_average_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (X : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] (ν : Measure X) (q : X → Euclid n) (h : X → ℝ), Measurable q → Integrable h ν → (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ a : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) a → HasCompactSupport a → (∀ y, 0 ≤ a y) → (∀ y, a y ≤ 1) → |∫ x, h x * a (q x) ∂ν| ≤ ε + C * ∫ y, a y) → ∀ K : Set (Euclid n), IsCompact K → volume K = 0 → ∫ x in q ⁻¹' K, h x ∂ν = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
